title: "Update Fails to Install: Persistent 'Restart to Apply' State"
body:
**Bug Description**
It will not apply the update. It says Restart to Apply permanently, the update never seems to apply.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.6
